office: Member of the National Council (Conseil national)
result: Elected. She won a Geneva seat for the Greens and became, at 27, the youngest member of the Swiss federal parliament at the time.

office: Member of the Council of States (Conseil des Etats)
result: Elected. She won the Geneva Council of States seat left vacant by the retiring Robert Cramer, entering the upper house in December 2019.

office: Member of the Council of States (Conseil des Etats)
result: Defeated. In the second round of the October/November 2023 federal election she failed to win re-election, finishing behind Mauro Poggia (MCG) and Carlo Sommaruga (PS) and losing her seat. She announced her withdrawal from politics, leaving the Council of States at the end of 2023.
